Type: V alid Description: AUTOSAR shall define an open architecture for automotive software which can be maintained, adapted and extended. Rationale: Findings from the application of AUTOSAR require maintaini ng AUTOSAR. Future requirements will increase the neces sity to further evolve AUTOSAR. Only common functionality will be standardized by AUTOSAR. Therefore the architecture shall be extendable without compr ising fundamental principles of the architecture.
